scope: saved N32 controls, positive budget attribution and observables of already-saved reference/grid arrays only
protocol_role: review arithmetic and provenance scope, not a new prospective physical experiment
budget_accounting: retain recorded per-case totals and original sequential model accumulation; exact rational sum of positive components with signed rounding residual recorded separately
H_formula: original (2 sqrt(M) max(1,max|c0|) b+b^2)/E0; no substitute formula or acceptance decision
H_diagnostic_rounding: read exact saved mass/c0 variance and retained saved sigma squared; report conservative rational denominator enclosure, do not replace saved binary64 indicator
observables: compute exact rational H of stored mass/c0 and stored continuous-grid/PDE states; no new arrays, exponential clock evaluations or reference solves
floor_interpretation: compare spatial-only diagnostic floor to both actual K16 H gap and stored continuous-time-grid H gap; not a new error certificate or new K simulation
attribution_interpretation: state-budget shares are not additive H shares; signed H bias cancellation may be described but cannot enter acceptance
next_step: if saved spatial floor remains above both gaps, close time-only expansion and register a separate minimal three-space-level affine control; do not execute it in this review
forbidden: retroactive pass,changed H indicator or thresholds,clipping,point repair,normalization,F/C fitting,new scientific N/K/model scan
